package parents

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/viant/bindly/resource"
	"github.com/viant/datly/bootstrap"
	gateway "github.com/viant/datly/gateway/http"
	"github.com/viant/datly/internal/testharness/sqlite"
	druntime "github.com/viant/datly/runtime"
	dsql "github.com/viant/datly/sql"
	"github.com/viant/sqlx/testutil/sqlfault"
)

func TestGeneratedInMemoryExecution(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	h := sqlite.New(t)
	require.NoError(t, h.ExecStatements(ctx,
		"CREATE TABLE parents(id INTEGER, summary TEXT)",
		"INSERT INTO parents VALUES(1,''),(2,'')",
		"CREATE TABLE lookup_values(feature_type TEXT, feature_value TEXT, score INTEGER)",
		"INSERT INTO lookup_values VALUES('a','shared',11),('b','shared',22),('a','decoy',99),('c','shared',88)"))
	var lookups atomic.Int32
	db := h.FaultDB(t, func(_ context.Context, call sqlfault.Call) error {
		if strings.Contains(call.SQL, "discovery_only") {
			return fmt.Errorf("intermediate discovery SQL executed: %s", call.SQL)
		}
		if call.Phase == "query" && strings.Contains(call.SQL, "lookup_values") {
			if !strings.Contains(strings.ToUpper(call.SQL), "WHERE") ||
				!strings.Contains(call.SQL, "feature_type") || !strings.Contains(call.SQL, "feature_value") ||
				!strings.Contains(call.SQL, "?") {
				return fmt.Errorf("nested lookup lacks bound key predicates: %s", call.SQL)
			}
			lookups.Add(1)
		}
		return nil
	})
	resources := resource.New()
	const pkg = "github.com/viant/datly/inmemoryfixture/parents"
	for namespace, fs := range bootstrap.LinkedResources(nil, pkg) {
		require.NoError(t, resources.Register(namespace, fs))
	}
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	sources, err := bootstrap.DiscoverComponentsFromPackages(ctx, filepath.Dir(cwd), []string{pkg}, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, sources, 1)
	component, err := sources[0].Resolve(reflect.TypeFor[ParentsInput](), reflect.TypeFor[ParentsOutput]())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	artifact, err := bootstrap.BuildArtifact(bootstrap.ArtifactInput{
		Component: component, InputType: reflect.TypeFor[ParentsInput](), OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[ParentsOutput](), Resources: resources,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	reader, err := artifact.ReaderCompilation().NewExecution(bootstrap.ReaderRuntimeConfig{SQL: &dsql.SQLComponent{DB: db}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	registered, err := artifact.Registration(druntime.RegisteredComponent{Reader: reader})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	rt, err := druntime.NewRuntime([]*druntime.RegisteredComponent{registered})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, rt.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
	handler := gateway.NewHandler(rt, nil, "test")
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, path, summary string
		lookups             int32
	}{
		{"populated", "/parents?id=1", "a/shared=11,b/shared=22", 1},
		{"empty", "/parents?id=2", "", 0},
		{"excluded", "/parents?id=1&fields=id", "", 0},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			lookups.Store(0)
			res := httptest.NewRecorder()
			handler.ServeHTTP(res, httptest.NewRequest("GET", tc.path, nil))
			require.Equal(t, 200, res.Code, res.Body.String())
			require.Equal(t, tc.lookups, lookups.Load())
			var actual map[string]any
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(res.Body.Bytes(), &actual))
			rows := actual["data"].([]any)
			require.Len(t, rows, 1)
			row := rows[0].(map[string]any)
			if tc.name == "excluded" {
				require.Len(t, row, 1)
				require.Contains(t, row, "Id")
			} else {
				require.Equal(t, tc.summary, row["Summary"])
				require.Empty(t, row["Signals"])
			}
		})
	}
}
